description: Weak certificate mapping (ESC10) abuse via a user account when StrongCertificateBindingEnforcement is relaxed.

telemetry.detail: Certificate request logged on the CA.
PKINIT TGT request with the issued certificate.
Certificate authentication succeeding under a weak/compatibility binding mode is the ESC10 signal.

prerequisite_privilege: Control of a victim user + weak DC certificate-binding enforcement
abuse_primitive: Change the victim UPN to a target, enroll, PKINIT as the target.
notes: Depends on StrongCertificateBindingEnforcement being Disabled/Compatibility on the DCs.
